section: Perspectives in Education · Ch4 — Teaching Methods (Complete)
subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: Two or more teachers jointly plan and deliver instruction to the same group of students, each contributing their specific subject expertise (e.g., one teaches concepts while the other demonstrates practical applications) within the same class period. This collaborative teaching arrangement is called:
explanation: Team teaching involves two or more teachers collaboratively planning and delivering instruction, distinct from multigrade teaching (ONE teacher handling multiple grade levels).

section: Perspectives in Education · Ch4 — Teaching Methods (Complete)
subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: A teacher pairs a student who has mastered a topic with a classmate who is struggling, having the stronger student explain and practice the concept together with the weaker one under teacher supervision. This strategy is called:
explanation: Peer tutoring pairs a more capable student with one who needs support — the tutor reinforces their own understanding by teaching, while the tutee gets individualised help.
